config.title: OpenRouter for Copilot
config.creditLimit.description: Set the local spending limit in USD. Zero disables this limit and shows the account balance; it does not change OpenRouter's server-side guardrail. Workspace overrides are ignored.
config.creditResetPeriod.description: Choose when the local spending limit resets: daily, weekly, monthly, or never. Workspace overrides are ignored.
config.creditIncludeByok.description: Include bring-your-own-key (BYOK) usage in the displayed usage and local spending-limit calculation. Workspace overrides are ignored.
config.creditRefreshIntervalMinutes.desc: Set how often usage and credit data refresh, in minutes (1-1440). Workspace overrides are ignored.
config.sanitizeBase64Content.description: Remove long base64-like strings from request text (messages, reasoning, tool-call arguments) before sending. Image attachments are unchanged. Workspace overrides are ignored.
config.hideUnavailableModels.description: Query the account's available models and hide models this key cannot use from the model picker. Falls back to the full catalog when the query fails. Workspace overrides are ignored.
config.outputReservePercent.description: Output reserve target as a share of the context window, in percent. The reserve is held back for the reply when OpenRouter's published max-completion cap is a synthetic placeholder or absent. 12.5% reserves ~131K on a 1M-token window. Bounded by the lower/upper token limits. Workspace overrides are ignored.
config.outputReserveMinTokens.descriptio: Lower bound on the output reserve, in tokens, applied to the ratio (default 16384, 16.384K), so tiny context windows still hold back a sane reply budget. A real published cap is never inflated up to this bound. Workspace overrides are ignored.
config.outputReserveMaxTokens.descriptio: Upper bound on the output reserve, in tokens (default 262144, 262.144K), so huge context windows do not reserve an absurd share while a current-generation model's real output cap is still honored. A real published cap is capped at this bound. Set both limits equal for a fixed reserve. Workspace overrides are ignored.
